title: Understanding Bias in Model A
text: When you remove a feature from a model, think about how it affects the model's ability to capture the underlying data patterns. Does removing a feature make the model simpler or more complex? How might this change the model's bias?

title: Effect of Removing a Feature
text: Consider how removing a feature might limit the model's flexibility. A less flexible model might not fit the training data as well, potentially increasing the bias. Think about how this relates to the bias-variance tradeoff.
